title: Grant evoke and offspring to spells as they are cast
clause: "Elemental permanent spells you cast from your hand gain evoke {4} as you cast them" (Ashling, the Limitless); "Creature spells you cast gain offspring {2} as you cast them" (Zinnia, Valley's Voice)
why: Granted alternative costs (effects/granted_alternative_cost.go keys: WUBRG, Free, Emerge, Miracle, WebSlinging...) have no evoke, and evoke's payoff is a sacrifice trigger on a permanent that does not print it. Granted optional costs (game/granted_optional_cost.go) cover only casualty (Silverquill); offspring's payoff (effects/offspring.go OffspringToken / offspringWasPaid) reads the card's OWN optional-cost index, not PaidCost.GrantedOptional. Both need the grant to carry its enters-trigger onto the resulting permanent. Ashling also needs 'sacrifice a nontoken Elemental -> token copy, sacrifice unless you pay WUBRG' (ordinary).
checked: grep 'gain evoke|gains evoke' and 'gains? offspring': 0 in effects and game; listed GrantedAltCost* keys in effects/granted_alternative_cost.go (no evoke); read game/granted_optional_cost.go header (casualty only); read func list of effects/offspring.go. We Ride at Dawn's granted convoke is NOT in this seam (precedent: hoarding_broodlord.go, eirdu_carrier_of_dawn.go, game/granted_tap_cost.go).

cards.name: Ashling, the Limitless
cards.oracle_text:
Elemental permanent spells you cast from your hand gain evoke {4} as you cast them. (If you cast a spell for its evoke cost, it's sacrificed when it enters.)
Whenever you sacrifice a nontoken Elemental, create a token that's a copy of it. The token gains haste until end of turn. At the beginning of your next end step, sacrifice it unless you pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
